lead_raw_text:
The structure of CoAsPd crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing six atoms—two Co, two As, and two Pd—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers with nine neighbors (four Co, five Pd), Co centers with ten neighbors (two As, four Co, four Pd), and Pd centers with ten neighbors (two Co, two As, six Pd). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between As and Pd 9- and 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Co 10-vertex polyhedra.
